notes.title: No-Hi Alpha is now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Discover an Unforgettable Journey - Join the Alpha of No-Hi![/h2]

We're beyond excited to announce that the alpha for No-Hi is officially live on Steam! This is your chance to be one of the first players to explore and test the world we've been passionately crafting. At this early stage, we’re eager to hear your feedback and find out what we can improve. 
[hr][/hr]
Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/8EMZ8YcY]Discord[/url] and become a part of No-Hi's development.

Support our project financially, crowdfunding campaign available on [url=https://www.catarse.me/no-hi]Catarse[/url].

Get ready to dive into this adventure and help shape the future of our game! We can’t wait to hear (and read, haha) your thoughts and work together to create the best experience possible!
[hr][/hr]
Download the alpha now and embark on this journey! 🦊
